evidence: Modifies the C kernel API in `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp` and `src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h` to prevent caching block validation flags across calls.
rationale: Fixes a correctness failure in the kernel API where cached validation flags cause invalid blocks to erroneously pass subsequent checks under different parameters. As noted in the description, 'a regtest block fails btck_block_check with mainnet params... After it has been checked once with regtest params, the same call with mainnet params returns 1', and signet blocks can be accepted such that the chain 'can't read its own tip back with btck_block_read'.
